Multiple modem versions with the same marketing name exist:
  • H/W ver: A1 - supported as config-less LTE interface from RoS v6.38
    Modem firmware version starting from "2.1.4EU".
  • H/W ver: A3 - works as config-less LTE using modem firmware provided RNDIS interface (RouterOS v7 only)

Config-less LTE interface for modems with vendor-id="0x12d1" device-id="0x14db"
Models with suffixes -320 and -608 will not work with RouterOS v6, please use v7 instead
Models with suffixes -325 work only with arm cpu

v6 and v7 - config-less LTE interface
v7 - by default will try to use the modem in MBIM mode

Serial/PPP interface, single AT/modem channel
Will not work on wAP R ac boards.

ppp/LTE interface.
RouterOS v6 CDC-ECM mode - LTE interface receive address in modem's internal network.
RouterOS v7 MBIM mode - LTE interface uses APN IP address.

RouterOS v6 CDC-ECM mode - LTE interface receive address in modems internal network.
RouterOS v7 MBIM mode - LTE interface uses APN IP address.
On some boards it may be required to disable SIM hot plug detection:


<br/>/interface/lte/set [find] modem-init="AT+QSIMDET=0,1"<br/>

Basic support with at-chat, minimum firmware revision: RG255CGLABR01A04M4G_A0.004.A0.004
Modem composition: at+qcfg="usbnet",0

MBIM mode with extended support for USB compositions:
  • 1009 - diag,modem,mbim
  • 100D - diag,nmea,modem,mbim
